gate_definition: holdout top-match >=95%, holdout accuracy >=95%, <=50% bf16 per-fact storage
interpretation: R288 showed that low-rank projection can destroy attention behavior despite modest L2 error. R290 preserves every KV dimension and reduces precision instead, including mixed K/V bit widths, a train-only shared anchor, and sparse residual error compensation. The holdout values are never used to fit the anchor and receive no gradient optimization.
